text:
Possibly, but the evidence does not establish that the loss was a eucalyptus harvest.

The 2023 tree-cover loss covered 0.7 hectares. Of that, 0.4 hectares overlapped a mapped eucalyptus plantation; the remaining 0.3 hectares lay outside mapped forest. The data confirm tree-cover loss, but do not identify its cause.

A further 0.4 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than the 0.5-hectare event threshold and was not counted as an event.
